info.title: DiagramGenerator for .NET (bnl-dotnet
info.description: Local command-line tool that analyzes a C#/ASP.NET Core solution via Roslyn and writes navigable Mermaid flow diagrams - your source code never leaves your machine. Free for single-method diagrams; a license unlocks fully composed, cross-method diagrams.

commands.name: basic
commands.description:
Free. Diagram a single method in isolation - no composition, no license needed.
Give no method to list them

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --output
options.description:
File to write the diagram to, or a
folder to write <Type.Method>.mmd into.
Defaults to the current folder

options.name: --stdout
options.description:
Write the diagram to STDOUT and nothing
else (for redirects and pipes). Cannot
be combined with -o

options.name: --format
options.description:
mermaid    mermaid (bare diagram text, .mmd) or
markdown (wrapped in a ```mermaid fence,
.md)

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
Choose the method from a menu (type to
filter, up/down to page) instead of
naming it

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress informational output

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Show every message MSBuild produced
while loading the project (long lists
are otherwise summarized)

arguments.name: PATH_OR_METHOD
arguments.description:
A .sln, .slnx or .csproj (or a folder containing one).
Omit to use the one in the current folder; if it's not a
project, it's read as the method instead

arguments.name: METHOD
arguments.description:
The method to diagram, e.g. OrdersController.Get or
OrdersController.Get(int). Omit to list what's available
